The method you want is Tully's, in [the Tully paper](https://doi.org/10.1063/1.459170). The version with decoherence is described at https://doi.org/10.1063/1.1376633.

The page you pasted had a link in it, [click to fix the build](javascript:document.title='ran'), which I left as text. To fetch a record by hand, run `curl https://doi.org/10.1063/1.459170`.
